final: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS total FROM member_totals), shares AS (SELECT m.link_to_member, m.total, 1.0 * m.total / g.total AS share FROM member_totals AS m CROSS JOIN grand_total AS g WHERE g.total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.total), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.value) FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.value IS NOT NULL AND s.share > a.value
